turns.user: For a 3DCP mortar with w/b 0.35, s/b 1.5, 90 % OPC + 10 % silica fume and 0.6 % PCE, plot the Bingham flow curve up to 100 1/s and the structuration curve over 45 minutes of rest, and compare both with measured literature curves.
turns.text:
I’ll use the pmpredict vocabulary and retrieve comparable measured curves from its literature database, then plot model and literature curves on the same axes. I’ll state assumptions for any missing mix or test conditions.
The model tools return the plotted curves and measured analogues together, so I’ll request both at the specified limits. Since no sand type or testing conditions were given, I’ll use the mortar default and mark those assumptions explicitly.
Both curves are plotted with the model estimates and measured literature analogues:

- [Bingham flow curve, to 100 s⁻¹](C:\Users\User\3D%20Printing%20Concrete%20Prediction\artifacts\reports\agent\20261017-013453-eade\flow_curve_agent_mix.png) · [CSV data](C:\Users\User\3D%20Printing%20Concrete%20Prediction\artifacts\reports\agent\20261017-013453-eade\flow_curve_agent_mix.csv)
- [Structuration curve, to 45 min](C:\Users\User\3D%20Printing%20Concrete%20Prediction\artifacts\reports\agent\20261017-013453-eade\structuration_agent_mix.png) · [CSV data](C:\Users\User\3D%20Printing%20Concrete%20Prediction\artifacts\reports\agent\20261017-013453-eade\structuration_agent_mix.csv)

For the assumed 3DCP mortar, the Bingham model gives **τ₀ = 234 Pa [16, 843]** and **μ = 6.43 Pa·s [0.84, 33.13]**. At 100 s⁻¹, predicted shear stress is **1,023 Pa [250, 3,901]**. The structuration model gives **τₛ(0) = 271 Pa [22, 9,125]** and **Aₜₕᵢₓ = 0.70 Pa/s [0.02, 13.67]**; at 45 minutes, **τₛ = 4,003 Pa [307, 61,123]**. Its Athix estimate is flagged weak, and the intervals are broad; treat these as guidance, not precise mix properties.

The closest measured flow analogues are M5 and M6 (DOI [10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158)) and M1 ([10.3390/buildings16030490](https://doi.org/10.3390/buildings16030490)). The closest measured structuration analogues are M2–M4 ([10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509)). The returned plots compare against these measured curves.

Assumptions: `is_3dcp=true`; default sand class and unspecified age/curing/rest conditions. Final mix behavior needs experimental verification.
